item.title: Operation Sagar Bandhu: India Sends 53 Tonnes of Relief to Sri Lanka, Brings Back 2,000+ Stranded Indians
item.description: Standing firmly with Sri Lanka after the massive devastation caused by Cyclone Ditwah, India has delivered 53 tonnes of relief material and rescued over 2,000 stranded Indian nationals from the island nation. Launched on November 28, Operation Sagar Bandhu aims to provide urgent search-and-rescue support and Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) to India’s closest maritime neighbour as severe floods, loss of life, and widespread damage continue across Sri Lanka. item.title: PM Modi Assures India’s Continued Support To Sri Lanka Under Operation Sagar Bandhu
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a telephonic conversation with the President of Sri Lanka, Anura Kumara Dissanayake, yesterday and assured him India’s continued support to Sri Lanka under the ongoing Operation Sagar Bandhu in providing rescue and relief to distressed persons. item.title: Pope Leo ends first foreign trip with silent prayer at Beirut blast site
item.description: Pope Leo XIV will offer a silent prayer at the site of the 2020 Beirut port explosion as he wraps up his first foreign trip to Turkey and Lebanon on Tuesday. He also will meet with relatives of some of the 218 victims of the blast on Aug. 4, 2020. The explosion tore through Beirut and did billions of dollars in damage after hundreds of tons of ammonium nitrate detonated in a warehouse. item.title: Travel from Delhi to Dehradun in just 2.5 Hours, new expressway trial run begins
item.description: The much-anticipated Delhi-Saharanpur-Dehradun Expressway has opened for a trial run, marking a major step forward in enhancing connectivity between the National Capital Region and Uttarakhand. Once fully operational, the new expressway is expected to reduce the Delhi-Dehradun journey from the current 6-6.5 hours to just 2-2.5 hours - a significant improvement for both frequent travellers and tourists heading towards the popular mountain destination. item.title: Eicher truck abandoned on SP Ring Road with ₹1.5 crore liquor consignment
item.description: The Gujarat State Monitoring Cell (SMC) has unearthed a major case of liquor smuggling after an Eicher truck carrying Indian-made foreign liquor (IMFL) worth over ₹1.50 crore was found abandoned near Bakrol Toll Plaza on the SP Ring Road late on Monday night. item.title: India Kick Off Their Campaign At Women’s FIH Hockey Junior World Cup With 13-0 Victory Over Namibia In Santiago
item.description: In women’s Hockey, the Indian junior team began its campaign in the FIH Junior Women’s World Cup with a 13-nil win against Namibia in Santiago, Chile. With this win, India climbed to the top of the table. Hina Bano and Kanika Siwach scored hat-tricks, while Sakshi Rana struck a brace. Binima Dhan, Sonam, Sakshi Shukla, Ishika, and Manisha each scored a goal. The team, led by Jyoti Singh, is drawn in Pool C along with Germany, Ireland, and Namibia. item.title: Dhurandhar Advance Booking: Ranveer Singh's spy action drama crosses 25,000 ticket sales
item.description: Ranveer Singh's upcoming spy action drama, Dhurandhar, directed by Aditya Dhar, has crossed the 25,000 ticket sales mark across the national chains, PVR Inox and Cinepolis, for the opening day, as of 11 PM (December 1, 2025). item.title: Swiggy plans $10,000 cr share sale next week, three banks shortlisted
item.description: Indian food deliverer Swiggy Ltd. is preparing to raise as much as ₹10,000 crore ($1.1 billion) from institutional investors as early as next week, according to people familiar with the matter.
